answer: Audits are published in quartz, queued in pearl, and comet publishes the wait time. A farm of 236 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 44 identities per epoch. A farm of 3260 identities would post 1544 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
